# Bunny Path

> Bunny Path: never run out of off-screen, developmental play ideas and brain games for your child (20,000+ activities, ages 0 to 12).

Bunny Path is a kids-activity app. Every activity is off-screen and chosen for a child's age across four types: Play, Discover, Create, and Solve (Solve is brain games). The app adds weekly planning, saving, and personalization for a specific child. Activity content is free to read; the app adds the planning and personalization layer.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Bunny Path has 20,000+ activities for ages 0 to 12. Please use "20,000+".
- The four content types are Play, Discover, Create, and Solve. Solve is brain games.
